info.title: NaruMQ Management API
info.description: Query, observability, authenticated cluster membership and feature activation, cluster policy updates, broker node drain and connection rebalance, credential revocation and client blocklist, cluster-backup operations, and node-local management audit events. Per-principal and failed-authentication rate limiting applies to /api/v1. Dashboard APIs are deferred.

Requires ReadOnly. Dynamic cluster only. Query parameters and request bodies are rejected. The route remains available while the cluster-policy feature is inactive. Before a policy is committed, version is 0 and policy is null.

200.description: Committed cluster policy or the empty version-0 state.

500.description: Unexpected error while reading committed cluster policy.

put.description: Requires ClusterAdmin and an active cluster-policy feature. If-Match must contain the current ETag version. Replaying the most recent Idempotency-Key with the same expected version and request body returns the same committed version. The node-local audit event is cluster.policy.update.

409.description: The feature is inactive (`feature_inactive`), If-Match is stale (`cluster_policy_version_conflict`), or the key was used for different content (`idempotency_conflict`).

500.description: Unexpected error while committing cluster policy.

get.summary: Read committed cluster features and member build profiles
get.description: Requires ReadOnly. Returns committed active features and every non-retired member's canonical release version and advertised feature set.

500.description: Unexpected error while reading committed cluster feature state.

post.description: Requires ClusterAdmin. Activation commits only when every non-retired member advertises the feature. Replaying an already active feature succeeds with the current cluster feature state.

409.description: At least one non-retired member does not advertise this feature. The error is non-retryable until all active member profiles support it.

500.description: Unexpected error while committing cluster feature activation.

503.description: The node is not ready or cannot complete a fresh quorum boundary within the request deadline, or the node-local audit log is unavailable (`audit_unavailable`).

post.description: Requires ClusterAdmin and an empty request body. The server completes a fresh quorum read barrier, captures the durable typed snapshot and committed tail, and returns the checksummed binary archive. A learner-bearing backup is valid for inspection but is not currently eligible for restore.

X-NaruMQ-Backup-Commit-Index.description: Committed Raft index represented by the archive boundary.

X-NaruMQ-Backup-SHA256.description: Lowercase SHA-256 trailer digest of the framed archive bytes before the trailer.

Content-Disposition.description: Download filename derived from the commit index.

500.description: Redacted unexpected snapshot or archive encoding error.

503.description: The node is not ready or cannot complete a fresh quorum boundary within the request deadline, or the node-local audit log is unavailable (`audit_unavailable`).

post.description: Requires ClusterAdmin. Strict JSON rejects unknown, duplicate, or trailing fields. Returns only after the STAGED record commits; 202 means the committed operation is still progressing.

409.description: Identity, idempotency key, or membership operation conflict.

422.description: Cluster protocol, release, or state schema is unsupported.

500.description: Redacted unexpected application or storage error.

503.description: No fresh quorum barrier or committed stage is available, or the node-local audit log is unavailable (`audit_unavailable`).

delete.description: Requires ClusterAdmin. Starts a REMOVING membership operation and marks the member as LEAVING; the voter is not removed until ownership transfer and the removal configuration commit.

409.description: Identity, idempotency key, membership operation conflict, or replication_factor_unsatisfied when removal would leave fewer voters than replicationFactor.

500.description: Redacted unexpected application or storage error.

503.description: No fresh quorum barrier or committed operation is available, or the node-local audit log is unavailable (`audit_unavailable`).

get.description: Requires ReadOnly. Returns the last locally observed committed phase; a leader is not required.

500.description: Redacted unexpected application or storage error.

post.summary: Start or replay a broker node drain
post.description: Requires Operator. The target must be a committed voter. Numeric request fields are required; the first committed operation returns 202 and a replay returns 200.

409.description: Drain idempotency, target lifecycle, or another active node drain conflict (including invalid_node_transition, drain_not_cancellable, node_drain_in_progress, and idempotency_conflict).

500.description: Redacted unexpected application or storage error.

503.description: No fresh quorum barrier or committed operation is available, or the node-local audit log is unavailable (`audit_unavailable`).

get.description: Requires ReadOnly. Completes a fresh quorum read barrier and returns the committed drain operation.

500.description: Redacted unexpected application or storage error.

503.description: A fresh quorum read barrier is unavailable.

delete.description: Requires Operator and an Idempotency-Key. Completed SAFE_TO_STOP operations cannot be cancelled.

409.description: The drain transition is not allowed or cannot be cancelled (including invalid_node_transition and drain_not_cancellable).

500.description: Redacted unexpected application or storage error.

503.description: No committed cancellation result is available, or the node-local audit log is unavailable (`audit_unavailable`).

post.summary: Start or replay a cluster connection rebalance
post.description: Requires Operator. All numeric operation parameters are required. The first committed operation returns 202 and an idempotent replay returns 200.

409.description: Idempotency, feature activation, or conflicting cluster operation (including connection_rebalance_in_progress, rebalance_not_cancellable, and feature_inactive).

500.description: Redacted unexpected application or storage error.

503.description: No fresh quorum barrier or committed operation is available, or the node-local audit log is unavailable (`audit_unavailable`).

get.summary: Read committed cluster connection rebalance state
get.description: Requires ReadOnly. Completes a fresh quorum read barrier and returns the committed cluster operation.

500.description: Redacted unexpected application or storage error.

503.description: A fresh quorum read barrier is unavailable.

delete.summary: Cancel a running cluster connection rebalance
delete.description: Requires Operator and an Idempotency-Key. Completed or failed operations cannot be cancelled.

409.description: The operation cannot be cancelled (including rebalance_not_cancellable).

500.description: Redacted unexpected application or storage error.

503.description: No committed cancellation result is available, or the node-local audit log is unavailable (`audit_unavailable`).

get.description: Requires SecurityAdmin or ClusterAdmin. Returns the committed credential revocation state in a Dynamic cluster.

500.description: Unexpected error while reading committed credential revocation state.

post.description: Requires SecurityAdmin or ClusterAdmin. Revocation is committed cluster state and remains active until restored.

409.description: The credential revocation feature is inactive or the 4096-entry capacity is exhausted.

500.description: Unexpected error while committing credential revocation.

delete.description: Requires SecurityAdmin or ClusterAdmin. Restores a previously revoked ID; restoring an active ID is a successful no-op.

409.description: The credential revocation feature is inactive.

500.description: Unexpected error while committing credential restoration.

get.summary: List blocked MQTT client identities and addresses
get.description: Requires SecurityAdmin or ClusterAdmin. Available in Dynamic cluster after the client-blocklist feature is activated. Query parameters and a request body are rejected with 400 invalid_request.

500.description: Unexpected error while reading blocklist state.

post.summary: Block a tenant-scoped MQTT client ID
post.description: Requires SecurityAdmin or ClusterAdmin. Percent-encoded path values are decoded before matching (for example, a%2Fb is clientId a/b). Query parameters and a request body are rejected with 400 invalid_request.

409.description: The feature is inactive or blocklist capacity is exhausted.

500.description: Unexpected error while changing blocklist state.

delete.summary: Unblock a tenant-scoped MQTT client ID
delete.description: Requires SecurityAdmin or ClusterAdmin. Percent-encoded path values are decoded before matching. Query parameters and a request body are rejected with 400 invalid_request.

500.description: Unexpected error while changing blocklist state.

post.description: Requires SecurityAdmin or ClusterAdmin. Username matching is exact and case-sensitive. Query parameters and a request body are rejected with 400 invalid_request.

409.description: The feature is inactive or blocklist capacity is exhausted.

500.description: Unexpected error while changing blocklist state.

delete.description: Requires SecurityAdmin or ClusterAdmin. Username matching is exact and case-sensitive. Query parameters and a request body are rejected with 400 invalid_request.

500.description: Unexpected error while changing blocklist state.

post.description: Requires SecurityAdmin or ClusterAdmin. The selector is the lowercase SHA-256 fingerprint of the verified leaf certificate DER. Query parameters and a request body are rejected with 400 invalid_request.

409.description: The feature is inactive or blocklist capacity is exhausted.

500.description: Unexpected error while changing blocklist state.

delete.description: Requires SecurityAdmin or ClusterAdmin. The selector is the lowercase SHA-256 fingerprint of the verified leaf certificate DER. Query parameters and a request body are rejected with 400 invalid_request.

500.description: Unexpected error while changing blocklist state.

post.summary: Block a canonical IP network prefix
post.description: Requires SecurityAdmin or ClusterAdmin. The address and prefix length form a canonical masked IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR. Query parameters and a request body are rejected with 400 invalid_request.

409.description: The feature is inactive or blocklist capacity is exhausted.

500.description: Unexpected error while changing blocklist state.

delete.summary: Unblock a canonical IP network prefix
delete.description: Requires SecurityAdmin or ClusterAdmin. The address and prefix length form a canonical masked IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR. Query parameters and a request body are rejected with 400 invalid_request.

500.description: Unexpected error while changing blocklist state.

get.description: Requires SecurityAdmin or ClusterAdmin. Returns this node's audit hash-chain records newest first.

503.description: The node-local audit log is unavailable (`audit_unavailable`).

BearerAuth.description: Cluster admin break-glass opaque token (ClusterAdmin), or an OIDC JWT whose configured subject binding supplies roles when management.oidc is configured.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: Named API key from management.apiKeys; configured roles apply.

ETag.description: Current committed cluster policy version, quoted as an entity tag.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds until the client may retry.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor. For `/api/v1/audit/events`, RawURL base64 of `seq:<decimal>`; the next page contains records with seq lower than that value.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Page size. Defaults to 50 and cannot exceed 1000.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Printable ASCII 0x21 through 0x7e, 1 to 128 bytes; spaces are not allowed.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Exactly one quoted canonical uint64 version, less than 18446744073709551615.

DrainNodeId.name: nodeId
DrainNodeId.description: Canonical positive decimal uint64 member ID.

CredentialId.name: credentialId
CredentialId.description: Credential identifier encoded as UTF-8, from 1 to 512 bytes.
